# moldandyeast.com

> Personal site of Ramon: a heading and four links. One self-contained HTML file with no build step, no trackers and no third-party requests. On wide screens it also opens a WebGL 2 physics room, with a full physics studio behind a "Studio" button.

The content is the same in every mode; the plain HTML in `<main id="site">` is the source of truth and the 3D room only mirrors it. For contact, use the links below.

## Contact

- [More about me](https://content.moldandyeast.com): background, writing and work
- [Reach out on X](https://x.com/nilsedison): @nilsedison

## This page

- [Markdown version](https://moldandyeast.com/index.md): the page's content as plain Markdown
- [HTML](https://moldandyeast.com/): the whole site, about 520 KB, all inline

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/moldandyeast/my-main-oct): MIT licensed and meant to be forked. `AGENTS.md` explains the layout, the invariants and how to deploy a fork to your own domain.

## Optional

- Studio documentation: embedded in the HTML inside `<section id="spec">`. It covers the YAML scene language, bodies, joints, rules, expressions, settings and the JavaScript sheet API. Give a model this file and ask for "a YAML scene for <game idea>"; paste the answer into the studio's Scene editor and press Run.
- URL anchors (wide screens with WebGL 2): `#studio` opens the studio; `#room`, `#structures`, `#siege`, `#rover`, `#stress2d`, `#mass`, `#demolition`, `#courier`, `#stress3d`, `#bowling`, `#expedition`, `#pinball` and `#quarry` open a sheet directly.
